main_text.p: alijs sacerdotibus eandē concludit: [illegible, ~40 letters] Idem ca.6. de eodem Christi sacerdotio differens, quòd diuinitus interposito ipsius Dei iurejurando fuerit constitutum & stabilitum, tandem hac clausula, consolationis plenissimâ mutitur: Et [illegible, ~60 letters] Capite deinceps: septimo, eandem; & quidem nullem ac salutarem canens de hoc Christi sacerdotio exantilenam Apostolus, cum Melchisedeco, Rege simul & sacerdote singulari & extraordinario primùm, deinde cum sacerdotibus ordinarijs comparat, tandemq; sermonem hunc suum his verbis concludit: [illegible, ~50 letters]
in quo similiter Christum cum reliquis sacerdotibus veteris Testamenti comparat, & veteris ac novi Testamenti differentiam explicat. Ab initio capitus: [illegible, ~70 letters]
Horum quasi epitome & summa sunt aurea illa Apostoli verba cap.9. [illegible, ~120 letters]

page.notes: The Greek passages are set in Greek type at a resolution too low to read reliably, so they are marked illegible rather than guessed. The Latin lines are copied as far as they could be read. Several Latin words at the line ends are doubtful and were not marked with [?] because the scan is too faint to settle them.
